title: Hatsune Miku — Empty SEKAI〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm bored.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Maybe I should sing something again.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... Hello, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hello♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey there! How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry I haven't been coming to visit...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-Why the blank look?
Are you disappointed it's just us this time?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's too bad because we're here and we're not going back just yet!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not a big deal or anything...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But Mafuyu told us to check in on you every now and then, so we dropped by!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She said that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. We were talking about you the other day, and she suggested that we go and see how you're doing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're making eye contact, so I guess you ARE listening?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sure she is.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You know, Miku, our group has started hanging out offline a lot lately.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We meet up at a diner. Do you know what that is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a casual restaurant. We meet up there and chat over some food. We're getting to know each other better.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. We're still trying to find out what the real Mafuyu is like, but who knows if we ever will...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: At least, we're doing our best and that's what matters.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think we're beginning to uncover the Mafuyu who's not just a goody two-shoes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, she does show another side of her personality every now and then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. Sometimes she gets this cold or dead look in her eyes, and that throws me off a bit...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's a little scary.
But at least that's the real her showing through her usual mask.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, anyway. Mafuyu's doing fine.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Not to say she's perfectly happy.
I'm sure she's still bottling up her feelings.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We don't meet up every day and we go to different schools, so I don't know what she's like most of the time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't even go to school most of the time, heh.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We're not talking about you now, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, what was that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu has you, so she's going to be fine now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe, you think so? She's our dear group member, after all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We've got to look out for each other.
If something were to happen, it would hit Kanade the hardest.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Admit it, you're worried about Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So what if I am! Get off my back!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ena... Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Please look after Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um, sure.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Since you're asking, I'll make an effort.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, bye for now. We'll see you again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Bye, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay... Bye.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And...thank you.
